verdict.rationale: Chronicle's own docs say traces can be sent from an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle, as an alternative to SDK ingestion (docs-32, docs-19). That covers the inbound half of the story, but retrieval is only described through Timeline or the SDK, not over OTLP, so the 'receive' half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: OTLP export/receive of traces, documented OTLP endpoint details (gRPC/HTTP, URL, auth/headers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the OTel ingestion.
